name: What should I look for when hiring a contractor for siding repair in San Mateo?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when hiring a contractor for siding repair in San Mateo?

acceptedAnswer.text: When hiring a contractor for siding repair in San Mateo, look for a licensed and insured general contractor with a strong reputation. Check their experience specifically with siding and window flashing. Ask for references and view examples of their past work. Ensure they provide a detailed, written estimate outlining the scope of work, materials, timeline, and cost. Verify that they offer warranties on their workmanship and materials. A good contractor will also communicate clearly and answer all your questions thoroughly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for a licensed, insured contractor with relevant experience, references, clear estimates, and warranties on their work.
